name: The University of Queensland
h1: One view of the Technology Master Plan
lede: UQ is delivering its Technology Master Plan across collaboration, identity, security and research computing. Airtable gives IT governance and faculties one connected view of that portfolio.
why_p: Several consolidation programs are running at once, each needing service, business, technical and budget owners to stay aligned.

signals.title: Bunya Phase 4.0 GPU upgrade nears go-live
signals.body: UQ's Research Computing Centre said Bunya Phase 4.0, with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, was almost complete and expected for research use in July 2026, with the next upgrade already in procurement.
signals.angle: Track research infrastructure upgrades, onboarding and demand in one shared register.

signals.title: UQ takes over the Queensland Nectar node
signals.body: The Research Computing Centre announced it would take operational responsibility for the Queensland node of the ARDC Nectar Research Cloud from QCIF on 1 July 2026.
signals.angle: Coordinate service transitions, stakeholders and support commitments without scattered spreadsheets.

signals.title: Okta rollout starts identity unification
signals.body: UQ began moving from Duo to Okta Verify, the first step in bringing sign-on and identity services onto one Okta platform over 2026 and 2027.
signals.angle: Run staged rollouts by cohort with clear owners, dates and status in one place.
